answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Copyist diploma sheet warrant lettered across the inkwell bench, proved by each diploma sheet is a measured sheet yield plus a calligrapher signature, checked by strangers. The workshop keeps the plume, the ledger keeps the relic, time itself keeps the wander — and none of the three works for the farm. Each proof takes 40 minutes of honest labour; 610 proofs take 24400 minutes, and the farm owns no shortcut. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass.
